card.summary: 基础会员 free: 最多 2 个云盘, 最多 1 个本地挂载, 2 devices, no core Pro features. '传输不限速' is listed as available even on the free tier.

free_tier.stated: 基础会员 free: 最多 2 个云盘, 最多 1 个本地挂载, 2 devices, no core Pro features. '传输不限速' is listed as available even on the free tier.
free_tier.notes: The free tier is counted in connected drives and mounts, not bytes.

per_object_cap.stated: Encrypted upload is capped at 200 MB per file on every tier except 核心终身版; the cloud drive's own per-file cap still applies beneath it.

retention.stated: Not applicable: it is a mount and a transfer layer, not a store.

egress.terms: '传输不限速' on every tier including free. Traffic is the cloud drive's traffic, so the pan's own quota binds, not CloudDrive2's.

record.interface_detail: The server runs on the local machine and exposes WebDAV; '独立 WebDAV 用户管理' is a Pro feature. Supported sources include 阿里云盘, 百度网盘, 115网盘, 天翼云盘, 123云盘, 迅雷云盘, OneDrive, Google Drive and WebDAV.
record.tooling: Windows/macOS/Linux/Docker server plus apps for phone, TV and headset. WebDAV means rclone, Infuse, VidHub and any player can mount it.
record.chaining: One licence turns five Chinese pans into one WebDAV endpoint, which is the piece AList does not sell: paid support, encrypted folders and cross-cloud copy in one binary.

limits.value: free tier: 2 drives, 1 mount; Pro unlock at ¥4.99/month
encrypted upload 200 MB/file below 核心终身版

identity_cost.detail: A CloudDrive account, purchased in-app through App Store or Google Play or directly. No phone gate is published.

record.reliability_note: The mount is a client-side process: 115's API suspension in 2026 broke third-party mounts for a period, which is the failure mode of every layer that sits on a pan's private endpoints.
record.confidence_note: The whole price ladder and the tier comparison table were read off the vendor's pricing page. No mount was run.

evidence.proved: 基础会员 free (2 drives, 1 mount); 核心会员 ¥4.99/月, ¥49.99/年; 轻享终身 ¥199; 核心终身版 ¥499; '传输不限速'; encrypted upload 200 MB cap named in the 终身 column
'云盘本地挂载' with full random read/write; supported pan list including 阿里云盘/百度网盘/115网盘/天翼云盘/123云盘/迅雷云盘

record.notes: Runs on a free VM or a local machine - it is software on somebody else's hardware either way. The 视障用户 lifetime tier at ¥299 is a real discount route documented on the page.
record.binding_note: A ¥4.99/month licence has no byte counter of its own; the pan's quota is what fails first. Naming a CloudDrive2 quota would misattribute another provider's limit.
